standard_prerequisites.name: Cech exactness for surjective flat lfp covers
LQCoh^{fbc} closure properties
standard_prerequisites.use: Pullbacks, pushforwards and the closing step preserve lqc+fbc.

core_obligations: Part (1): lqc from lemma-check-lqc-on-etale-covering, fbc from lemma-check-flat-comparison-on-etale-covering (proof lines 1255-1257).

Part (2) single cover: Cech sequence for surjective flat lfp qcqs a (cited exactness-cech-complex); b^*F lqc+fbc as pullback (loc-qcoh-fbc proposition); a_*a^*F, b_*b^*F lqc+fbc (same proposition); F lqc+fbc (same proposition closes) (proof lines 1264-1286).

Part (2) reduction: smooth presentation U -> X, part (1) twice (stack and Zariski local), fppf covering factoring through the f_j refined to a standard covering, apply the single-cover case (proof lines 1289-1306).
proof_roadmap: Combine the two property-specific descent lemmas for part (1).
Close the Cech sequence in LQCoh^{fbc} and reduce part (2) to a standard cover.
difficulty_reason: Part (1) is the combination of the lqc descent lemma and the fbc descent lemma, one per property. Part (2) is a two-stage argument: the Cech exact sequence 0 -> F -> a_*a^*F -> b_*b^*F closes inside LQCoh^{fbc} using the loc-qcoh-fbc proposition three times, and the general covering is reduced to a single standard fppf cover by Zariski localization and the surjective-family lemma.
